label: Ember Knight — shifted form
placeholderNameStatus: PLACEHOLDER. Not approved as a name. Do not use it as an id.
notForImportNote: Motion concept for the Manager. Do not copy these sheets into the game until the Manager approves them.
anchorNote: Feet. Same camera as the approved shift still: ground line at 85% of the frame. 0.85 * 512 = 435.2.
sheetLayout: Rows are directions, top to bottom, in the order above. Columns are frames, left to right, no padding. Straight alpha.
camera: Orthographic, 35 degrees down, 2.6 tiles across. Same camera as incoming-art/ember-knight-shift-drafts/source/build_ember_shift.py.
model: Approved shifted form. Round body, shield arm, bar arm. No separate legs.

idle.note: Style-guide idle rate. A small breathe and a core pulse. The earlier floating specks were removed. No flash.

walk.note: 10 frames at 30 fps. The Manager set the walk speed at 1.6 tiles a second. The Programmer tunes playback. The sheet has a bigger bob than idle and two stubby boots stepping under the hem. The round body is unchanged.

attack.name: ember slash
attack.note: Ember slash. 18 telegraph ticks then 22 recover ticks at 20 ticks a second. Frame 9 is the hit. Frames 0-8 cock the bar back and up while the body leans back. Frame 9 sweeps across the front with a short gold-orange arc. Then follow-through and recovery. Arms are thicker than the first pass. No red on the knight.

shift.note: Same clock as the approved shift. 1.0 s white-gold, then a 0.5 s settle (one gold ring, one steam puff). These are the sample times, not a smooth film.

shiftReduced.note: Same 1.5 s. Quieter glow, then a crossfade to the still form. No ring, no steam, no embers.

sparkShield.name: Spark Shield
sparkShield.note: The shield comes forward. Gold motes sit on the rim. A Strike is what breaks it; this art does not draw a red circle. The plan line did not give tick counts, so this is 16 frames at 10 fps.

forgeSweep.name: Forge Sweep
forgeSweep.note: Dash-only wide blade arc. The blade stays visible. The gold arc is warm gold, not red and not the game's purple stripe. The plan line did not give tick counts, so this is 16 frames at 10 fps.
